explanation: EXCLURAD was run with the documented standard CLAS12 eta settings (model 3, full O(alpha) mode, 6.53 GeV electron beam, fixed proton target, recoil proton, vcut=0.166 GeV^2). sigma_Born is the unpolarized Born cross section written in radtot.dat: 0.0008651649. delta is null because EXCLURAD wrote NaN for sigar(1)/sibar(1) in radtot.dat (and NaN in radcor.dat); its radiative-tail integration diagnostics contained non-finite quadrature values. The requested kinematics themselves are physical.
